summary: Xeris Biopharma filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of privately negotiated exchange transactions with holders of its 8.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028. Exchanging noteholders swapped ~$23 million in principal for ~5 million common shares plus ~$23 million cash; a separate conversion of $10.5 million principal into ~3.6 million shares eliminated all remaining notes. The cash portion came from on-hand liquidity. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2) and Section 3(a)(9) exemptions. This is a debt-to-equity restructuring, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, no risk-arb angle; focus on the balance sheet cleanup.
